description: Build a ready-to-send first message to Egor in his four-point brief format, plus a Telegram link with the text prefilled and a mailto link. The user reviews and sends it personally: this tool sends, stores and books nothing. Use after check_shooting_fit; tell the user about the `missing` points before sending. Do not include names, phone numbers or other personal data.
